verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Atlas issues founder equity with customizable vesting, files 83(b) elections for all C-corp founders, obtains EIN, and provides Cooley-developed legal templates and incorporation documents — covering stock purchase, IP assignment (via Cooley templates), and 83(b). Community corroborates smooth incorporation and paperwork experience, though some note added legwork/gaps still required. Missing for 10: independent verification of IP assignment document specifics and no hands-on account of the 83(b) filing mechanics beyond docs claims.
